scenes.say: True or false? If you have diabetes, fruit is off the menu.
scenes.headline: TRUE OR FALSE?

quiz.statement: Fruit is bad if you have diabetes.
quiz.label: TRUE OR FALSE?

scenes.say: Myth! The American Diabetes Association says you can eat fruit. Just count the carbs.
scenes.headline: FRUIT CAN FIT
scenes.sub: Count it as part of your carbs

scenes.say: Whole fruit brings fiber. A cup of raspberries has about fifteen grams of carbs and eight of fiber.
scenes.headline: 1 CUP RASPBERRIES

scenes.say: Round two is the sneaky one. Dried fruit is just as good as fresh?
scenes.headline: ROUND TWO

scenes.say: Myth! Two tablespoons of raisins has about the same carbs as a whole cup of raspberries.
scenes.headline: DRIED IS DENSE

scenes.say: Swap the raisins for a bowl of fresh berries. Way more to eat for your carbs.
scenes.headline: SMART SWAP

scenes.say: Fruit isn't the enemy. Whole fruit, sensible portion, pair it with protein, and it fits.
scenes.headline: FRUIT IS NOT THE ENEMY
